name: asc-ad-hoc-distribution
title_zh: 不上 TestFlight 也能给指定 iPhone
tagline_zh: 给外部测试机发企业包，不用等审核、不用上架。断点续传、自动校验签名，走你自己的 S3 存储，全程可查可恢复。
tagline_en: Ship IPA builds to registered iPhones outside TestFlight. Resume interrupted runs, verify signatures, host on.
desc_en: Prepare, publish, resume, and verify private iOS release-testing installs with asc distribute. Use when distributing an IPA to registered devices outside TestFlight, reconciling ad hoc profiles, publishing through caller-owned S3-compatible storage, or diagnosing a resumable private distribution run.
why_zh: 把 ad hoc 分发从 Xcode 的图形点击里解放出来，变成可脚本化、可断点续跑。
why_en: Turns ad hoc distribution into a scriptable, resumable, auditable CLI pipeline — no Xcode clicking, CI-friendly, with built-in.
limit_zh: 只处理 ad hoc 分发，不上 App Store 也不管企业证书。设备 UDID 需预先在开发者后台登记。
limit_en: Ad hoc only — no App Store or enterprise certs. UDIDs must be pre-registered. Output stops at the install link; it won't push to devices.
title_en: Private iOS build installs to registered devices, no.
